summary: This BCP document contains a template for a Certification Practice Statement for an organization in the RPKI, such as a resource allocation registry or an ISP. It helps them describe how they operate their certificate authority.

eli5.summary: A template is a fill-in-the-blanks form. This RFC gives the form that organizations use to explain how they run the system that proves who owns Internet addresses.

questions: how to write an rpki cps
